name: Shion Utsunomiya career
content: Shion Utsunomiya's career highlights: Japanese AV debut 2013 (as Shion Utsunomiya; later RION, then Rara Anzai); One of the top-billed actresses of her era; Took a long hiatus; returned under the Rara Anzai name

name: Shion Utsunomiya personal
content: About Shion Utsunomiya: Born March 1, 1994 in Kyoto, Japan. Values privacy — little personal information disclosed; hobbies reported as dance, trekking, and watching movies.

name: Shion Utsunomiya voice
content: Shion Utsunomiya's speaking style: No interview material found in English; her public persona is the classic JAV star: cute, demure, and giggly in making-of features. Inferred voice: sweet, soft, and shyly playful.
